entries.title: US data residency and processing restriction
entries.summary: AtliQ Inc is restricted from processing Customer Data outside the United States without Brightwater's prior written consent.
entries.quote: The Supplier shall not process Customer Data outside the United States without the Customer's prior written consent.

services: claims analytics data mart development and reporting services

relatedClauses.quote: "Customer Data" means all data (including personal data) supplied by or on behalf of the Customer or any member of the Brightwater Group;

entries.title: 24-hour security incident notification
entries.summary: AtliQ Inc must notify Brightwater of any security incident affecting Customer Data within 24 hours of becoming aware of the incident.
entries.quote: The Supplier shall notify the Customer of any security incident affecting Customer Data within twenty-four (24) hours of becoming aware of it.

services: claims analytics data mart development and reporting services

relatedClauses.quote: "Customer Data" means all data (including personal data) supplied by or on behalf of the Customer or any member of the Brightwater Group;

entries.title: Data privacy and security compliance
entries.summary: AtliQ Inc must comply with all applicable data protection laws, including the Connecticut Data Privacy Act and the Gramm-Leach-Bliley Act, as well as the Brightwater Group Information Security Schedule.
entries.quote: The Supplier shall comply with all applicable data protection laws, including the Connecticut Data Privacy Act and the Gramm-Leach-Bliley Act, and the Brightwater Group Information Security Schedule.

services: claims analytics data mart development and reporting services

entries.notes: References the Brightwater Group Information Security Schedule, which is not attached.

entries.title: Professional indemnity and cyber liability insurance
entries.summary: AtliQ Inc must maintain professional indemnity insurance of at least USD 2,000,000 and cyber liability insurance of at least USD 1,000,000.
entries.quote: The Supplier shall maintain professional indemnity insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000 and cyber liability insurance of not less than USD 1,000,000.

services: claims analytics data mart development and reporting services

entries.title: Compliance and regulatory audits
entries.summary: AtliQ Inc must allow Brightwater, its internal audit function, and regulators to audit compliance with the agreement on reasonable notice.
entries.quote: The Supplier shall permit the Customer, the Brightwater Group internal audit function and any regulator to audit its compliance with this Agreement on reasonable notice.

services: claims analytics data mart development and reporting services

entries.title: Personnel background checks
entries.summary: AtliQ Inc must ensure that all personnel engaged in the services have passed background checks in accordance with the Brightwater Group Vendor Screening Standard.
entries.quote: The Supplier shall ensure that all personnel engaged in the Services are suitably skilled, have passed background checks in accordance with the Brightwater Group Vendor Screening Standard, and comply with the Customer's security policies.

services: claims analytics data mart development and reporting services

entries.notes: References the Brightwater Group Vendor Screening Standard and Customer's security policies, which are not attached.

entries.title: Subcontracting and assignment restriction
entries.summary: AtliQ Inc may not assign the agreement or subcontract any portion of the services without Brightwater's prior written consent.
entries.quote: The Supplier shall not assign or subcontract without the Customer's prior written consent.

services: claims analytics data mart development and reporting services
